name: Anatomy Learning Labs: Neural Lab
summary:
Step into the Neural Lab of the Anatomy Learning Labs series, where the communication network of the human body comes to life in stunning 3D. Featuring anatomically accurate models developed by medical professionals and learning activities designed by professors, the Neural Lab teaches elementary, middle, and high school learners how the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerves work together to control movement, sensation, and thought.

This app leverages the Quest's audio, visual, and hand-tracking capabi
